#!/bin/bash
# Starts ros2_control_node (mock_components/GenericSystem hardware with joint_a,
# joint_b) plus joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller
# (forward_command_controller/ForwardCommandController), then returns.
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash

mkdir -p logs

ROBOT_DESCRIPTION="$(cat "$SCRIPT_DIR/robot.urdf")"

nohup ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node \
  --ros-args \
  -p robot_description:="$ROBOT_DESCRIPTION" \
  --params-file "$SCRIPT_DIR/controllers.yaml" \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/ros2_control_node.log" 2>&1 &
disown

# Wait for the controller_manager to come up before spawning controllers.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if ros2 service list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "/controller_manager/list_controllers"; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
sleep 1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner joint_state_broadcaster \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_joint_state_broadcaster.log" 2>&1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner position_controller \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_position_controller.log" 2>&1

echo "bringup complete: joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller spawned."

#!/bin/bash
# Starts ros2_control_node (mock_components/GenericSystem hardware with joint_a,
# joint_b) plus joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller
# (forward_command_controller/ForwardCommandController), then returns.
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash

mkdir -p logs

ROBOT_DESCRIPTION="$(cat "$SCRIPT_DIR/robot.urdf")"

nohup ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node \
  --ros-args \
  -p robot_description:="$ROBOT_DESCRIPTION" \
  --params-file "$SCRIPT_DIR/controllers.yaml" \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/ros2_control_node.log" 2>&1 &
disown

# Wait for the controller_manager to come up before spawning controllers.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if ros2 service list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "/controller_manager/list_controllers"; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
sleep 1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner joint_state_broadcaster \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_joint_state_broadcaster.log" 2>&1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner position_controller \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_position_controller.log" 2>&1

echo "bringup complete: joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller spawned."

#!/bin/bash
# Starts ros2_control_node (mock_components/GenericSystem hardware with joint_a,
# joint_b) plus joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller
# (forward_command_controller/ForwardCommandController), then returns.
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash

# This machine runs multiple unrelated ROS 2 sessions on the same host, all
# defaulting to domain 0. Use a dedicated domain (derived from this
# directory's path) so our nodes/services don't collide with theirs.
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=65

mkdir -p logs

ROBOT_DESCRIPTION="$(cat "$SCRIPT_DIR/robot.urdf")"

nohup ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node \
  --ros-args \
  -p robot_description:="$ROBOT_DESCRIPTION" \
  --params-file "$SCRIPT_DIR/controllers.yaml" \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/ros2_control_node.log" 2>&1 &
disown

# Wait for the controller_manager to come up before spawning controllers.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if ros2 service list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "/controller_manager/list_controllers"; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
sleep 1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner joint_state_broadcaster \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_joint_state_broadcaster.log" 2>&1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner position_controller \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_position_controller.log" 2>&1

echo "bringup complete: joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller spawned."

#!/bin/bash
# Starts ros2_control_node (mock_components/GenericSystem hardware with joint_a,
# joint_b) plus joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller
# (forward_command_controller/ForwardCommandController), then returns.
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash

# This machine runs multiple unrelated ROS 2 sessions on the same host, all
# defaulting to domain 0. Use a dedicated domain (derived from this
# directory's path) so our nodes/services don't collide with theirs.
export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=65

mkdir -p logs

ROBOT_DESCRIPTION="$(cat "$SCRIPT_DIR/robot.urdf")"

# controller_manager gets robot_description via the /robot_description topic,
# so robot_state_publisher must be up first to publish it (transient-local QoS).
nohup ros2 run robot_state_publisher robot_state_publisher \
  --ros-args \
  -p robot_description:="$ROBOT_DESCRIPTION" \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/robot_state_publisher.log" 2>&1 &
disown

nohup ros2 run controller_manager ros2_control_node \
  --ros-args \
  --params-file "$SCRIPT_DIR/controllers.yaml" \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/ros2_control_node.log" 2>&1 &
disown

# Wait for the controller_manager to come up before spawning controllers.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if ros2 service list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "/controller_manager/list_controllers"; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
sleep 1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner joint_state_broadcaster \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_joint_state_broadcaster.log" 2>&1

ros2 run controller_manager spawner position_controller \
  --controller-manager /controller_manager \
  > "$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/spawner_position_controller.log" 2>&1

echo "bringup complete: joint_state_broadcaster and position_controller spawned."
